//: Water filters and purifiers (Prologue rule, 29.09.2026). Code: src/game/survival/WaterFilters.js. `drink` filters (a lifestraw) are sucked through: untreated water listed in `treats`, from a river, a lake or a container, goes down as `clean` water while the filter is carried or lies on the ground here, each measure of water (one charge of `water`) spending `chargesPerUnit` of the filter's charges; when it cannot pay a measure it is clogged, and the water is drunk untreated again. `container` purifiers (charcoal jugs, the battery purifier) treat water standing in a container through the crafting recipe `recipe`, which spends the same `chargesPerUnit` a measure; a charcoal purifier that can no longer pay is spent: take it apart and make it again with fresh charcoal. Every number is CDDA's: charges_per_use and the pocket or initial charges.
